label: GO step late in the episode (trials 90-99) after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2) and only in the last ~10-20 trials of the episode: 98.7% of activation mass is in trials 90-99, with none before trial 80. Within that range it strongly prefers trials where the previous trial was unrewarded (98% of mass has prev_reward == 0), and it tracks the low value-head output late in the episode (99.9% of mass at value < 5.22). It does not fire after a rewarded trial or at fixation/state steps. Magnitude goes up with episode trial (within a window, later trials are more active) and is higher when the previous choice was a2 (82% of mass); adding prev_action == 2 raises F1 only slightly (0.52 vs 0.49) and drops mass recall, so I left it out. Precision is limited (~0.35): many late, post-unrewarded GO steps stay silent, so the feature looks like a graded end-of-episode / low-expected-value signal and not a crisp binary. All variables used are observed (no future variables).
